simulate_poisson_noise_on_image: simulate Poisson noise on a numpy image array using the _simulate function
run_PoissonNoiseModelCPUImpl_simulate: run the PoissonNoiseModelCPUImpl simulate static method to apply Poisson noise to an image
create_PoissonNoiseModel_instance: create a PoissonNoiseModel instance registered with the habitat_sim registry for color sensor noise
test_PoissonNoiseModel_is_valid_sensor_t: test the PoissonNoiseModel is_valid_sensor_type method to check if a sensor type is COLOR
apply_PoissonNoiseModel_to_image: apply Poisson noise to an image using the PoissonNoiseModel apply method as an alias for simulate
